newsitem.title: USA: American Dental files patent suit.
newsitem.headline: American Dental files patent suit.

text.p: American Dental Technologies Inc said Monday it filed a patent infringement lawsuit against Kreativ Inc of Albany, Ore.
The suit was filed in federal court in Corpus Christi, Texas.
"ADT developed modern air abrasive and laser dentistry and holds numerous basic patents in both areas," Ben Gallant, ADT president, said in a statement.
He added that ADT believes these patents cover not only devices, but also methods of using them for cavity preparations. He alleged that Kreativ has violated "at least two of our strongest patents."

ADT said it sued Kreative last year for allegedly disseminating false information regarding ADT's products. It said the judge in that case issued a temporary restraining order. A hearing on that case is expected sometime within the next year.
Kreativ was not immediately available for comment.
